summary: This bill amends the Specialty Crops Competitiveness Act of 2004 to establish a program that awards grants to eligible organizations to promote and expand the domestic market for domestically produced specialty crops.

scores.thoughts: This bill authorizes $75,000,000 for fiscal year 2026 and each fiscal year thereafter to establish a grant program for promoting specialty crops. This directly increases government spending.

The bill creates a new USDA grant program for domestic specialty crop marketing and authorizes $75 million in annual appropriations starting in FY2026 with no offsets, revenue measures, or spending reductions elsewhere. This directly increases federal outlays and therefore widens the deficit to fund an agricultural priority.
